svg.title: Which Cloudability package fits
svg.desc: The three Cloudability packages as IBM describes them: Essentials, for organizations establishing FinOps fundamentals like multi-cloud cost visibility and rightsizing; Standard, for teams advancing FinOps, adding unit economics, total cloud program cost allocation, cloud financial planning and workload planning; Premium, additional capabilities above the Standard package.
